info.title: finwire.pl - Public financial data API
info.description: Open API: NBP policy rates, CPI inflation, FX rates, 10-year bond yields, flat transaction prices (RCN, GUS), rents and rental yield, housing supply, wages by occupation, unemployment, government bonds, property tax limits, macro calendar and finwire indicators (credit stress map, barometers). Cite as: Source: finwire.pl, https://public-api.finwire.pl
